ClGmsClusterMemberEjectCallbackT clGmsMemberEjectCallback
 Pointer to the Eject Callback funtion.
 

Detailed Description

This structure contains the cluster managing callbacks provided at the joining time by the member.

The structure contains the eject callback which is called when the member is ejected from the cluster, the callback is invoked after the member is ejected and the reason for ejection is passed as argument to the callback.
